settings_allow_anonymous_hint: Answers are stored with no submitter. Nobody can be messaged, given roles, or replied to.
settings_allow_external_hint: Lets anyone with the link submit, even if they have not joined.
settings_allow_multiple: Allow more than one answer per person
settings_allow_multiple_hint: Off means one submission each. Turn on for things like weekly check-ins.
settings_allow_resubmit_hint: A rejected answer no longer counts as their one submission, so they can correct it and resend.
settings_announce_channel_hint: Posts a message when the opening time passes, or immediately if you publish with no opening time.
settings_announce_message_hint: The body of the launch message. The closing time is added as a countdown.
settings_announce_role_hint: Mentioned in the launch message. Nothing else pings this role.
settings_announced: Announced {date}. Changing the opening time will not send it again.
settings_anonymous_roles_note: This form is anonymous, so it records nobody to give roles to. The role settings below are hidden until you turn that off.
settings_appeal_delay_hint: Days somebody must wait after being banned before they may appeal at all.
settings_approval_add_roles_hint: Given to the person when their answer is approved.
settings_approval_remove_roles_hint: Taken away when their answer is approved. The waiting role above is removed anyway.
settings_approve_emote_hint: Shown on the approve button. Empty uses the server default.
settings_auto_approve_roles: Roles waiting for them on join
settings_auto_approve_roles_hint: Applied when the accepted person actually joins, not when they are approved.
settings_ban_appeals_review: Ban appeals always go through review.
settings_basics_summary: What this form is called and where its answers go.
settings_block_reappeal_hint: A rejected appeal is the end of it. Overrides the two limits below.
settings_expires_at_hint: The form stops accepting answers at this moment.
settings_form_description_hint: Shown under the title, and used as the preview when the link is pasted into Discord.
settings_form_name_hint: Shown as the title of the form and in your list of forms.
settings_form_type_hint_create: Decides who may submit. This cannot be changed afterwards.
settings_form_type_hint_edit: Decides who may submit. Fixed once the form is created.
settings_guild_review_buttons_hint: The emotes on the approve and reject buttons posted with each submission. Leave either empty for a plain tick or cross.
settings_guild_subtitle: Applied to every form here unless a form sets its own.
settings_how_often_somebody_may_appeal_s: How often somebody may appeal, and how long they must wait.
settings_how_the_invite_works_for_summar: How the invite works for people accepted into the server.
settings_invite_max_age_hint: How long the accepted person has to use it. 86400 is a day.
settings_invite_max_uses: Times the invite can be used
settings_invite_max_uses_hint: Usually one, so the invite cannot be passed around.
settings_is_active_hint: Turn off to close the form without deleting it.
settings_is_draft_hint: A draft is not reachable by its link, however it is shared.
settings_join_applications_review: Join applications always go through review.
settings_limits_on_who_may_open_summary: Limits on who may open and send this form.
settings_max_appeals_hint: How many rejected appeals before they are locked out for good.
settings_max_responses_hint: The form closes itself once this many people have answered, across everyone.
settings_min_account_age_hint: Turns away accounts newer than this many days. Useful against throwaway accounts.
settings_notify_role_hint: Mentioned in the channel above each time somebody answers, so reviewers notice.
settings_opens_at_hint: The form turns people away until this moment. Leave empty to open as soon as it is published.
settings_pending_role_hint: Held only until the answer is approved or rejected, then removed automatically.
settings_reappeal_cooldown_hint: Days after a rejection before they may appeal again.
settings_reject_emote_hint: Shown on the reject button. Empty uses the server default.
settings_rejection_add_roles_hint: Given to the person when their answer is turned down.
settings_rejection_remove_roles_hint: Taken away when their answer is turned down.
settings_require_approval_hint: Each answer waits for a decision. Without this, answers are simply recorded.
settings_require_captcha_hint: Adds a verification step before answers can be sent.
settings_required_role_hint: Only people holding this role can open the form. Everyone else is turned away.
settings_reviewer_role_hint: Can press the buttons on the submission in Discord. Anyone with Manage Server can regardless.
settings_scheduling_limits_and_how_often: Scheduling, limits, and how often one person may answer.
settings_submit_channel_hint: Each submission is posted here as an embed. Leave empty to keep answers on the dashboard only.
settings_submit_roles_hint: Granted the moment somebody answers, before anyone reviews it. Useful for a waiting-room role.
settings_success_message_hint: Shown on the confirmation page once someone has sent their answers.
settings_tell_people_what_this_form_plac: Tell people what this form is for.
settings_webhook_url_hint: Also posts each response to this address, for feeding another system.
settings_whether_answers_are_approved_by: Whether answers are approved, by whom, and what a decision does.
settings_who_gets_told_and_what_summary: Who gets told, and what the person who answered receives.

version_empty: Nothing saved yet. A version is kept every time this form is saved.
